question: Does the frozen self-adaptive deployment form pass robustly at untouched ICU sites, without any local calibration study?

databases.SICdb: Salzburg Intensive Care database (PhysioNet), single site
databases.HiRID: HiRID (PhysioNet, Bern University Hospital), single site
databases.Zigong: Critical care database comprising patients with infection at Zigong Fourth People's Hospital v1.1 (PhysioNet, credentialed), single site; ICU departments are care units

prior_project_use: none. Repository-wide search on 2026-10-18: HiRID is mentioned only as not run because the data was absent (GREYBOX_HYBRID_AUDIT.md) and SICdb/HiRID as future validation targets; neither database is on this machine.

deployment_form.point_model: frozen MIMIC-IV catalog recipe per cell (mimiciv_all_49_runtime_cells_development_rescue_audit_20260816.json), trained on MIMIC v4 data
deployment_form.recipe_rule: osler_jepa.recipe_availability.deployable_recipe: treatment-context ridge falls back to measurement-pure ridge when the site records none of the target's permitted treatment features
deployment_form.day_one_weighting: covariate-shift weights from the inputs of the first min(200, 25%) arriving stays (no labels)
deployment_form.interval: v2 value-bin normalization + DtACI meta rate 20, site and care-unit levels (site_adaptive_dtaci_dev_20261017.json)
deployment_form.comparison: static v2 interval on the same streams

preconditions_before_any_label_is_read: data access approved under PhysioNet credentialing and each database's terms

an extractor per database producing transitions in the MIMIC-IV contract: 6h anchor step, 6h look-back, label = nearest measurement within min(2, h/2) hours of anchor + h, 72h episode cap, plausibility cleaning as in mimiciv_observation_transition_extract.py

variable mapping declared from the data dictionary only, following the harmonized definitions: glucose = chemistry laboratory glucose; point-of-care glucose -> glucose_poc; blood-gas glucose -> glucose_bg; nurse-validated vital signs where the database distinguishes them; urine output interval-normalized to mL/hour; MAP = measured mean pressure
an addendum file recording the SHA-256 of each extractor and mapping file, written before the extracted labels are opened

evaluation.cells: all 49 catalog cells; continuous cells via site_adaptive_external_audit.py, binary event cells via multi_sample_external_audit.py
evaluation.stream: the database is one site; stays in fixed random arrival order (seeded), chronological within a stay; outcome resolves at anchor + horizon; at most 60,000 rows per cell
evaluation.samples: 5 MIMIC training samples of 15,000 rows (sample 0 = original seed)
evaluation.gates: point: patient-cluster paired bootstrap CI upper < 0 vs persistence and vs the recipe's comparator; interval: patient-equal and care-unit-equal whole-stream coverage in [0.87, 0.93]

primary_endpoint: per database: number of evaluable cells that are robust under the adaptive deployment form
secondary: per-cell coverage and MAE relative to persistence
decision_rule: cells robust on both SICdb and HiRID are independently replicated adaptive cells; robust on one = candidate. Any registry change requires the user's approval.
one_shot_rule: each database is scored once; only crashes may be fixed, without changing methods, gates or cohorts, and every fix is reported
refreeze_rule: if any hashed file changes before scoring, a new protocol version must be frozen before any label is read
supersedes: adaptive_model_lockbox_protocol_v2_20261018.json; re-frozen because the Zigong extractor changed before any label was read

zigong_addendum.data_access: assumed: the user holds PhysioNet credentialed access and signed this dataset's DUA; archive SHA-256 matches the official SHA256SUMS
zigong_addendum.prior_project_use: none (not present on this machine before 2026-10-18)
zigong_addendum.inspected_before_freeze: file list, data dictionary, column names, laboratory item/unit/reference-range metadata; value magnitude of two non-target inputs only (nursing blood_sugar -> mmol/L; FIO2 -> empty). No target value was read. After the v2 extraction, only support counts and timestamps were inspected: nursing-chart MAP is empty; nursing ChartTime has day-level resolution (median distinct-time spacing 24 h, 23% missing, 6% before admission); laboratory LabTime is minute-level and complete. No target value was read.
zigong_addendum.extractor: zigong_observation_transition_extract.py (mapping and unit factors inside; hashed below)
declared_differences: infection-only cohort (disease-enriched, like the eICU sepsis module)
treatment context not extracted (prescriptions only): treatment-context recipes fall back to the measurement-pure ridge
chemistry glucose is sparse (most glucose is blood gas -> glucose_bg); glucose cells may lack support
times are hours from hospital admission; ICU stays are ICU-department transfer segments

nursing chart excluded (day-level timestamps cannot guarantee causal as-of inputs or hourly labels): vital-sign, urine-output and hypoxemia cells are not evaluable; vital-sign inputs are absent and imputed with MIMIC training medians
not mapped: BNP (MIMIC uses NT-proBNP) and CK-MB (activity vs mass)
zigong_addendum.extraction: zigong_observation_transitions_{h}h.parquet for h in 1, 3, 6, 12, 24, 48 with 6h anchor step
